sentences.text: 2. Apprehending his arrest, the applicant has approached this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail, in connection with Complaint P.S. Case No.1954 of 2020, for the offence under Sections 406, 420 & 417 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi.
3. Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for co-operating with the investigating agency and participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that there was an agreement for sale and purchase of the land between the parties.
It is at best the civil case which has wrongly been converted into criminal case by lodging the complaint petition.

On the above basis,
prayer for bail has been made.
4. Learned counsel for the State as well as the learned counsel for the O.P No.2 have opposed the prayer for bail.

sentences.text: 5. Considering the nature of transaction between the parties, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

Accordingly, the applicant is directed to surrender in the court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender, the court below shall enlarge the applicant on bail on his furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi, in connection with Complaint P.S. Case No.1954 of 2020, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.

Further, the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
